EA_GPKG_INDEX_REPLACES_SHP
LiDAR Composite and SurfZone download ZIPs now contain GeoPackage indexes instead of shapefile indexes.
EA_GPKG_INDEX_SPATIAL
The GeoPackage index records the spatial location of raster elevation data.
EA_GPKG_INDEX_TEMPORAL
The GeoPackage index records the temporal extent of raster elevation data.
EA_INDEX_SEASON
LiDAR index catalogues include the time of year in which data was collected.
EA_WMS_IMAGE_ONLY
The LiDAR WMS preview is an image and cannot be queried for numeric values.
EA_COVERAGE_WMS_FOOTPRINT
Coverage-metadata WMS previews show raster extents rather than elevation values.
EA_OGC_DSP_AUTHORITATIVE
The Defra Data Services Platform describes itself as the authoritative source for externally published Defra data.
OS_T50_3_5_YEAR_FLYING
OS Terrain 50 is maintained through an integrated three-to-five-year flying programme.
OS_T50_SYNC_OTHER_PRODUCTS
Terrain updates are synchronised with other Ordnance Survey product updates.
OS_T50_NETWORK_MODELLING
The product specifically models significant features, particularly networks.
OS_T50_SMALL_SCALE_INTEROP
OS Terrain 50 is designed to work with Ordnance Survey small-scale data.
OS_T50_INSPIRE_READY
The product is designed to be INSPIRE-ready.
OS_T50_GRID_RMSE_4M
OS Terrain 50 grid data has been verified at 4 metres RMSE.
OS_T50_GPS_COMPARISON
The published RMSE assessment was derived by comparison with GPS points in sample areas.
OS_T50_APPLICATION_ASSET
Asset and site management is a documented product application.
OS_T50_APPLICATION_SIGNAL
Signal propagation is a documented product application.
OS_T50_APPLICATION_GEOLOGY
Geological analysis is a documented product application.
OS_T50_APPLICATION_VIEWSHED
Viewshed modelling is a documented product application.
OS_GRID_NO_TILE_OVERLAP
The centre-of-pixel grid construction creates no overlaps between adjacent tiles.
OS_GRID_NO_COMMON_EDGE_VALUES
Adjacent grid tiles do not share common edge values.
OS_GRID_CRS_POST_CALC
A DTM coordinate reference system can be used to calculate the origin and coordinates of individual posts.
OS_TIDAL_HEIGHT_CONTINUOUS
Mean high and low water heights vary continuously around the coast of Great Britain.
OS_TIDAL_LINES_LARGE_SCALE
Mean high and low water lines are derived from Ordnance Survey large-scale mapping.
OS_TIDAL_TILE_AVERAGE
Tidal lines receive a constant height based on an average calculated for each tile.
OS_TIDAL_TABLE_SOURCE
The tile-average tidal height is derived from local tide tables.
OS_TIDAL_BREAKLINES
Mean high and low water lines are used as heighted breaklines when creating the grid.
OS_TIDAL_CONSISTENCY
The tidal breaklines are used to keep grid and contour products consistent.
OS_TIDAL_ADJACENT_STEP
Local tidal averaging can produce a small discrete water-height step between adjacent tiles.
OS_MLW_EXTENDED_TILE_EDGE
In permanent tidal water, mean low water height is extended to the tile edge to complete the grid.
OS_FORESHORE_INTERPOLATION
Foreshore heights are interpolated between mean high and mean low water heights.
OS_CONTOUR_POLYLINE_SPOT
Contour data is represented through polyline and spot-height features.
OS_CONTOUR_GIS_ANALYSIS
Contour values can be viewed and analysed in a GIS.
OS_PROPERTYVALUE_INSPIRE
The contour GML stores height values in the INSPIRE-derived propertyValue attribute.
OS_SHP_FIELD_LIMIT
Shapefile field names are limited to ten characters.
OS_PROP_VALUE_ABBREVIATION
The shapefile representation abbreviates propertyValue as PROP_VALUE.
OS_NO_CONTOURS_FORESHORE
No contour lines are supplied between the mean high and low water lines.
OS_WATER_CATEGORY_FOUR
LandWaterBoundary supports four water-level categories across England, Wales and Scotland.
OS_SPOT_NOT_GUARANTEED_SUMMIT
An algorithmic spot height is not guaranteed to be the actual summit or highest feature point.
OS_SPOT_FUTURE_ENRICHMENT
The data model allows future enrichment with additional spot-height types.
OS_XML_CONTOUR_SCHEMA

OS_XML_GRID_SCHEMA
Ordnance Survey publishes an XML schema resource for gridded products.
OS_XML_STYLE_METADATA
Ordnance Survey publishes viewing-style metadata for Terrain XML resources.
OS_XML_REPOSITORY_LICENSE
Use of the XML schemas is governed by the XML File Repository Licence.
OS_T50_INERT_DATA
OS Terrain 50 is supplied as inert data rather than as manipulation software.
OS_T50_HARDWARE_RANGE
